podcast.body: The band provided backing for Nick Lowe on his single "American Squirm." "For this track, Low was backed by Elvis Costello and the attractions."

podcast.title: Formation for Second Album
podcast.body: The Attractions were formed by Elvis Costello for his second album because Clover (his backing band for "My Aim Is True") was unavailable and "lacked a certain intensity." The band consisted of "music industry vets." "That's when Elvis Gustell finally formed his own group. The attractions were made up of some music industry vets and they would join Elvis off and on over the next couple of decades."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: What's The Big Deal About Elvis Costello

podcast.title: Long-term Collaboration
podcast.body: The Attractions collaborated with Elvis Costello "off and on over the next couple of decades," providing a consistent musical partnership throughout much of his career. "The attractions were made up of some music industry vets and they would join Elvis off and on over the next couple of decades."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Reunion for "Blood and Chocolate"
podcast.body: After a period where Costello primarily used The Attractions for live gigs and worked solo in the studio, the band reunited for the 1986 album "Blood and Chocolate," which was described as a return to his "old school" sound. "But then in 1986, there was a reunion. The album was called Blood and Chocolate."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: What's The Big Deal About Elvis Costello

podcast.title: Saturday Night Live Opportunity
podcast.body: The Attractions, along with Elvis Costello, only secured their gig on *Saturday Night Live* because the original scheduled guests, The Sex Pistols, were unable to perform due to visa issues. "Elvis Costello and the attractions only got the SNL gig because original guests, the sex pistols, who were hamstrung by visa issues, could not make it."

podcast.title: Second Album Backup Band
podcast.body: The Attractions became Elvis Costello's crack backup band, but they did not form until his second album. His debut album, My Aim Is True, was recorded with a different, uncredited American band called Clover (performing as The Sham Rocks). "But that band didn't come together until the second album."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: If That Is Your REAL Name

xref.title: Saturday Night Live Defiance (1977)
xref.body: On December 17, 1977, Elvis Costello and his band, The Attractions, were booked for Saturday Night Live as a last-minute replacement for the Sex Pistols. The show's producers specifically forbade him from performing "Radio Radio." Despite his initial agreement, Costello stopped his scheduled song and played "Radio Radio," creating a memorable and rebellious moment in live television. "Great new rock moment number 59. The night Elvis Costello screwed the producers of Saturday Night Live."

xref.title: Clover's Transformation into Huey Lewis and the News
xref.body: The band Clover provided backup instrumentation for Elvis Costello's debut album, *My Aim is True*, performing under the name The Shamrocks. After their work with Costello, and once he had auditioned players for his permanent group (The Attractions), Clover returned to the United States and subsequently changed their name to Huey Lewis and the News, becoming the well-known band.

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Saturday Night Live Cancellation
xref.body: As a direct result of their visa delays, the Sex Pistols were unable to appear on "Saturday Night Live" as scheduled. Their slot was instead filled by Elvis Costello and the Attractions. "As a result of all the visa delays, the sex pistols weren't able to appear on Saturday night live as scheduled."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Saturday Night Live Fill-in
xref.body: Elvis Costello and the Attractions filled in for The Sex Pistols on "Saturday Night Live" when the latter's US tour visas were delayed, preventing them from appearing as scheduled. "Their slot instead was filled by Elvis Costello in the attractions."
